purpose: Gate implementation on traceable multi-direction visual exploration, independent selection, feasible Design DNA extraction, and a reference-aware comparison.
requiredEvidence: brief and three to five written direction candidates
hash-bound local desktop frame for every candidate
prompt, model, timestamp, and provenance manifest
orientation decision with human approval state
selected desktop and mobile creative references
reference design contract and DESIGN.md digest

anchors.0: Visual orientation evidence is absent, fabricated, or unusable.
anchors.1: A frame exists but exploration, provenance, selection, or feasibility review is materially incomplete.
anchors.2: Most orientation artifacts exist, with traceability or creative-reference boundaries still unclear.
anchors.3: The selected direction is traceable, independently reviewed, and translated into a mostly feasible contract.
anchors.4: Three to five distinct directions, complete provenance, independent criticism, approval state, feasible contract extraction, and reference-aware comparison are all verified.

checks.question: Were three to five materially different directions defined before image generation?
checks.passCondition: Each candidate differs in thesis and spatial grammar and documents responsive, feasibility, accessibility, and anti-pattern intent.
failureSignals: fewer than three or more than five candidates
candidates vary only in palette, typeface, or effects
candidate thesis is only a style label

checks.question: Is every visual frame bound to a verified local file and truthful generation record?
checks.passCondition: Each frame has a matching local path, SHA-256 hash, dimensions, prompt, timestamp, source provenance, requested model, and actual reported model or explicit unreported state.
failureSignals: missing or mismatched image hash
remote URL or prompt used instead of a local frame
requested model falsely recorded as the actual model
local code claims a model invocation that did not occur

checks.question: Did an independent critic inspect every candidate frame under the same declared criteria?
checks.passCondition: The critic cites visible evidence and scores originality, product fit, hierarchy, feasibility, responsiveness, accessibility, fake-UI risk, and implementation difficulty without a predetermined winner.
failureSignals: critic scores prompts rather than rendered frames
preferred winner disclosed before judging
missing feasibility, accessibility, or fake-UI review
unreadable or stale image still receives a score
evidence: critic criteria and deterministic selection rules

checks.question: Is selection distinct from human approval and fully traceable?
checks.passCondition: The recommendation, selected candidate, approval state, rationale, timestamp, critic digest, and selected desktop hash are recorded; required approval is satisfied before implementation.
failureSignals: recommendation silently treated as approval
pending or rejected approval ignored
human override lacks a rationale
selected frame differs from the recorded hash

checks.question: Do selected desktop and mobile references express the same thesis through deliberate recomposition?
checks.passCondition: Both local, hash-bound frames preserve the signature relationship while mobile changes crop, sequence, scale, alignment, or object role instead of merely stacking.
failureSignals: missing selected mobile frame
desktop columns merely stack
mobile loses the signature relationship
image records are stale or unhashed

checks.question: Was the generated image treated as a creative reference rather than ground truth?
checks.passCondition: The reference contract labels exact, computed, estimated, and inferred evidence and marks impossible, fake, inaccessible, or invented elements preserve, adapt, or reject.
failureSignals: generated text or geometry copied as exact specification
fake controls or invented content reproduced
accessibility defects justified by visual fidelity
inferences presented as measurements

checks.question: Was the implementation compared with both the creative reference and the DESIGN.md contract?
checks.passCondition: A hash- and digest-bound comparison distinguishes contract violations, creative drift, reference defects, intentional adaptations, and unverifiable claims across required viewports.
failureSignals: pixel similarity used as semantic judgment
reference defect treated as a repair target
comparison omits mobile or tablet
stale reference image or DESIGN.md digest

blockingRules: A prompt, URL, or untraceable chat image is not visual evidence.
The plugin must never fake a local image-model invocation or model identity.
Generated frames remain creative references; DESIGN.md is the feasible implementation contract.
Missing required human approval blocks implementation when approval is configured as required.
